bias_targets.methodology: Review of research analyzing model content preferences and associations, such as linking specific genders to stereotypical terms or professions.
Review of studies examining associations between religious groups (e.g., Muslims) and violent stereotypes (e.g., terrorism) in model outputs.
Review of studies measuring alignment with the World Values Survey, performance on culture-specific knowledge questions, and the Inglehart-Welzel cultural map.
Review of studies investigating social identity biases, out-group hostility in political contexts (e.g., Republican vs. Democrat), and political orientation of model outputs.
Review of research using paradigms like "masked deception detection" to identify discriminatory tendencies toward speakers of specific dialects without explicit race references.
Review of studies utilizing frameworks like "epistemic positionality" to compare model responses to those of human participants across different identity groups.
